limits: The reader timeline contains at most 20 events and exposes only normalized time, a fixed event class, a valid operation stage and a restricted error code. Actor, IP, endpoint, namespace, effect and other raw detail fields are never returned or rendered.

The timeline reads the existing app_platform audit trail and is governed by the existing audit cleanup target (365-day default, 30-day floor). Audit cleanup still ships disabled by default, so enabling a bounded production retention remains an owner decision rather than being silently changed here.
The administrator progress and task pages remain the stronger operational surfaces; this reader projection does not expose arbitrary server logs.
